prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D fantasy RPG building sprite. Create a completely redesigned TIDE TRAINING lodge for Riptide RPG, inspired closely by the TWO reference Home buildings (the tavern and blacksmith). Both images are STYLE and MATERIAL references, not buildings to copy literally. Match their richer sculpted hand-painted game-art finish: deep warm walnut timber, strong carved beams, dark charcoal stone foundations, saturated oxblood/red curved tiled roofs with thick layered eaves, amber glowing windows and hanging lanterns, subtle warm gold metal trim, dramatic readable light and shadow. The previous lodge looked too plain and flat: this should look like an impressive beast trainer's guild house that belongs alongside those Home buildings. Design one compact two-storey lodge with a bold central gable, a smaller attached side wing, a short red-roofed corner turret with a restrained gold finial, strong arched front doorway at the lower front, ornate wooden brackets and carved beast-head details on the eaves. Above the entrance is a handsome dark timber sign with a gold paw-and-lasso crest, and the only lettering reads exactly 'TIDE TRAINING', in the same warm gold serif style as the Home signage. Two small deep teal cloth pennants with simple gold paw emblems, warm doorway lanterns, a coiled lasso and a compact wooden training target beside the side wall identify the animal-training purpose. Make it cool, sturdy, adventurous and slightly imposing while retaining the charming chunky game proportions. Do not turn it into a cute toy cottage or modern smooth vector drawing. Keep building silhouette cohesive and compact, slightly elevated three-quarter/isometric view facing down toward the viewer, with the entry on the visible front face. Standalone whole building entirely inside the image with 4-6 percent transparent margin, complete roof and entire low irregular stone foundation visible. Fit the foundation across the lower central 75 percent width; the lowest step should be at about 95 percent image height. One single house only, no scene, no yard, no fences, no surrounding terrain, no people or live animals, no floating UI, no labels outside the sign. Actual transparent alpha background; solid opaque building interior; no white fringe, no gray glow, no diffuse light or drop shadow outside the clean silhouette. Strong upper-left lighting, richly shaded materials, same perspective and polished painted detail as the references.
